svg.title: Ghoulish
svg.desc: Ghoulish unblocked games catalog. Open this SVG directly in a browser.

xhtml:iframe.title: Ghoulish unblocked games catalog
xhtml:iframe.allow: autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad *; clipboard-write; clipboard-read; encrypted-media; accelerometer; gyroscope

svg.script:
<html lang="en"><head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Ghoulish is a fast, searchable catalog of unblocked browser games from GN-Math, Lumin, and Noah's Tutoring.">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#060506">
  <title>Ghoulish</title>

  <link id="favicon" rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">
<style>
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Ghoulish — unblocked games catalog
   Plain CSS. Black-and-red shell with per-source themes, high-contrast,
   responsive, no external dependencies.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

:root {
  color-scheme: dark;

  --bg: #060506;
  --bg-soft: #0b090a;
  --panel: #110e0f;
  --panel-2: #181315;
  --panel-3: #221a1d;
  --border: rgba(255, 241, 243, 0.08);
  --border-strong: rgba(255, 241, 243, 0.16);

  --text: #fff7f8;
  --text-soft: #e5d6d9;
  --muted: #b7a2a7;
  --muted-2: #9f868c;

  --accent: #ff3b4e;
  --accent-hover: #ff5c6b;
  --accent-ink: #220207;
  --accent-rgb: 255, 59, 78;
  --accent-deep: #b31227;
  --accent-deep-rgb: 179, 18, 39;

  --source-gn-math: #ff2f43;
  --source-gn-math-rgb: 255, 47, 67;
  --source-lumin: #2dd4bf;
  --source-lumin-rgb: 45, 212, 191;
  --source-noahs-tutoring: #ffb020;
  --source-noahs-tutoring-rgb: 255, 176, 32;

  --danger: #ff5c6b;

  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius: 14px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
  --max-width: 1440px;
  --gutter: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px);
  --bar-height: 58px;

  font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI",
    Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 100vh;
  color: var(--text);
  background:
    radial-gradient(980px 600px at 82% -12%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.14), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(820px 620px at -8% 4%, rgba(var(--accent-deep-rgb), 0.17), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 420px at 50% 108%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.055), transparent 70%),
    var(--bg);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

body[data-theme="gn-math"] {
  --accent: var(--source-gn-math);
  --accent-hover: #ff5566;
  --accent-ink: #220206;
  --accent-rgb: var(--source-gn-math-rgb);
  --accent-deep: #a80e22;
  --accent-deep-rgb: 168, 14, 34;
}

body[data-theme="lumin"] {
  --accent: var(--source-lumin);
  --accent-hover: #5eead4;
  --accent-ink: #03211d;
  --accent-rgb: var(--source-lumin-rgb);
  --accent-deep: #0f766e;
  --accent-deep-rgb: 15, 118, 110;
}

body[data-theme="noahs-tutoring"] {
  --accent: var(--source-noahs-tutoring);
  --accent-hover: #ffc14d;
  --accent-ink: #241400;
  --accent-rgb: var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb);
  --accent-deep: #b45309;
  --accent-deep-rgb: 180, 83, 9;
}

body.player-open,
body.settings-open {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------ Background presets */

body[data-bg="grid"] {
  background-color: #040506;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(900px 560px at 76% -10%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.2), transparent 64%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(4, 5, 6, 0.05), rgba(4, 5, 6, 0.88) 72%),
    linear-gradient(rgba(255, 247, 248, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 247, 248, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: auto, auto, 48px 48px, 48px 48px;
  background-attachment: fixed;
  background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat, repeat, repeat;
}

body[data-bg="fog"] {
  background-color: #040506;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(900px 620px at 12% 8%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(800px 620px at 92% 28%, rgba(103, 136, 166, 0.14), transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 700px at 50% 105%, rgba(var(--accent-deep-rgb), 0.22), transparent 68%),
    linear-gradient(155deg, #0a0c10 0%, #050607 48%, #080509 100%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

body[data-bg="midnight"] {
  background-color: #04040b;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(950px 580px at 78% -12%, rgba(92, 86, 214, 0.17), transparent 65%),
    radial-gradient(1.2px 1.2px at 18% 26%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 72% 64%, rgba(255, 238, 240, 0.45), transparent),
    radial-gradient(1.4px 1.4px at 42% 84%, rgba(174, 190, 255, 0.45), transparent),
    linear-gradient(165deg, #090d20 0%, #04050d 55%, #080409 100%);
  background-size: auto, 220px 180px, 310px 260px, 170px 230px, auto;
  background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat, no-repeat;
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

/* A custom image keeps a dark wash and accent glow on top for contrast. */
body.has-bg-image {
  background-color: var(--bg);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(900px 560px at 82% -10%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16), transparent 64%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.74) 0%, rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.86) 48%, rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.93) 100%),
    var(--bg-image);
  background-size: auto, auto, cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-attachment: fixed;
}

img {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}

button,
input {
  font: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 12px;
  left: 12px;
  z-index: 300;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: var(--accent-ink);
  background: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateY(-160%);
  transition: transform 0.18s ease;
}

.skip-link:focus {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Header */

.topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.82);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
}

.topbar-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  min-height: 76px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 12px var(--gutter);
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.brand-mark {
  display: block;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #0a0a0a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.28),
    0 8px 30px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.22);
}

.brand-mark svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.brand-mark .brand-frame {
  fill: var(--accent-deep);
  transition: fill 180ms ease;
}

.brand-mark .brand-person {
  fill: var(--accent);
  transition: fill 180ms ease;
}

.brand-mark .brand-letter {
  stroke: var(--accent-hover);
  transition: stroke 180ms ease;
}

.brand-copy {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.brand-name {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.115em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.brand-tag {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.search-field {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: min(440px, 100%);
}

.search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 14px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--muted);
  stroke-width: 1.8;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#search {
  width: 100%;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0 52px 0 42px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  outline: none;
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 14px;
  transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease;
}

#search::placeholder {
  color: var(--muted);
}

#search:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

#search:focus {
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.65);
  background: var(--bg-soft);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.15);
}

/* Hide the default WebKit search cancel button in favour of our own styling. */
#search::-webkit-search-cancel-button {
  appearance: none;
}

.search-hint {
  position: absolute;
  right: 11px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: 23px;
  height: 23px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--muted);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.topbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 10px;
  flex: 0 1 500px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.topbar-actions .search-field {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  max-width: 440px;
}

.settings-button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--muted);
  transition: border-color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.settings-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text);
}

.settings-button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.settings-button svg {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Layout */

.page {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--gutter) 72px;
}

.intro {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 36px;
  padding: clamp(38px, 6vw, 72px) 0 34px;
}

.eyebrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.live-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.14);
}

.intro h1 {
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 62px);
  font-weight: 820;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  line-height: 0.98;
}

.intro h1 span {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-shadow: 0 0 38px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.24);
}

.lede {
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 20px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: clamp(14px, 1.5vw, 16px);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.stats {
  display: flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  gap: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--border);
}

.stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 128px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  background: rgba(18, 14, 16, 0.9);
}

.stat-value {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.stat-label {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Featured */

.featured {
  padding: 0 0 28px;
}

.featured-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.featured-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.featured-title::before {
  content: '';
  width: 4px;
  height: 17px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.55);
}

.featured-note {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.featured-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
}

.featured-card .card-art {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
}

.featured-card .card-title {
  font-size: 14px;
}

.featured-card.is-hero {
  grid-column: span 2;
  grid-row: span 2;
}

.featured-card.is-hero .card-open {
  flex: 1;
}

.featured-card.is-hero .card-art {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 270px;
  aspect-ratio: auto;
}

.featured-card.is-hero .card-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Skate 3's box art is portrait, so show it whole over a blurred fill. */
.featured-card.is-hero .card-art.is-portrait {
  background-color: #080708;
}

.featured-card.is-hero .card-art.is-portrait::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: -30px;
  z-index: -1;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.12), rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.62)),
    var(--hero-cover) center / cover no-repeat;
  filter: blur(20px) brightness(0.62) saturate(1.15);
  transform: scale(1.05);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.featured-card.is-hero .card-art.is-portrait img {
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 4px;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 20px 44px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6));
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- Catalog bar */

.catalog-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 14px 0 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.filters {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.filters::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.filter {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 650;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease;
}

.filter:hover {
  color: var(--text);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
}

.filter.is-active {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text);
}

.filter-count {
  min-width: 18px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.filter.is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* The All view uses the global red theme; each source pill uses its own. */
.filter[data-source="all"].is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.42);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.09);
}

.filter[data-source="all"].is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.filter[data-source="gn-math"].is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-gn-math-rgb), 0.42);
  background: rgba(var(--source-gn-math-rgb), 0.09);
}

.filter[data-source="gn-math"].is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--source-gn-math-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--source-gn-math);
}

.filter[data-source="lumin"].is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-lumin-rgb), 0.42);
  background: rgba(var(--source-lumin-rgb), 0.09);
}

.filter[data-source="lumin"].is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--source-lumin-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--source-lumin);
}

.filter[data-source="noahs-tutoring"].is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb), 0.42);
  background: rgba(var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb), 0.09);
}

.filter[data-source="noahs-tutoring"].is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--source-noahs-tutoring);
}

.source-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--muted);
}

.source-dot.source-gn-math {
  background: var(--source-gn-math);
}

.source-dot.source-lumin {
  background: var(--source-lumin);
}

.source-dot.source-noahs-tutoring {
  background: var(--source-noahs-tutoring);
}

.result-count {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- Notice */

.notice {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.28);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.07);
}

.notice-mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.notice-text {
  flex: 1;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.notice-text strong {
  color: var(--text);
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- Grid */

.catalog {
  padding-top: 24px;
}

.game-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(168px, 1fr));
  gap: 22px 16px;
}

.game-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.card-open {
  /* Keep programmatic scrolling/focus from landing under the sticky header. */
  scroll-margin-top: 96px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 9px;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
}

/* Per-source accent: cards keep their library's colour even when the page
   shell is themed for a different source. */
.game-card[data-source="gn-math"] {
  --card-rgb: var(--source-gn-math-rgb);
}

.game-card[data-source="lumin"] {
  --card-rgb: var(--source-lumin-rgb);
}

.game-card[data-source="noahs-tutoring"] {
  --card-rgb: var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb);
}

.game-card[data-source] .card-art {
  border-color: rgba(var(--card-rgb, var(--accent-rgb)), 0.16);
}

.card-art {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background:
    linear-gradient(145deg,
      hsl(var(--hue, 24) 34% 16%) 0%,
      hsl(calc(var(--hue, 24) - 10) 30% 6%) 100%);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.card-art::after {
  /* Thumbnail fallback: the game's initials, shown if the image fails. */
  content: attr(data-initial);
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: rgba(255, 241, 243, 0.62);
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3.2vw, 34px);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  z-index: -1;
}

.card-art.is-fallback::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.card-art img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.35s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;
}

.card-art.is-fallback img {
  display: none;
}

.game-card:hover .card-art {
  border-color: rgba(var(--card-rgb, var(--accent-rgb)), 0.5);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42),
    0 0 24px rgba(var(--card-rgb, var(--accent-rgb)), 0.12);
}

.game-card:hover .card-art img {
  transform: scale(1.045);
}

.card-open:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}

.card-open:focus-visible .card-art {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.card-source {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 8px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  max-width: calc(100% - 46px);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 4px 7px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.78);
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.055em;
  line-height: 1;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.card-source .source-dot {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
}

.card-source[data-source="gn-math"] {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-gn-math-rgb), 0.28);
}

.card-source[data-source="lumin"] {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-lumin-rgb), 0.3);
}

.card-source[data-source="noahs-tutoring"] {
  border-color: rgba(var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb), 0.3);
}

.card-source.card-author {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  color: var(--text);
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
}

.card-download {
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  right: 8px;
  z-index: 3;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: rgba(6, 5, 6, 0.8);
  color: var(--text-soft);
  cursor: pointer;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.card-download:hover {
  border-color: rgba(var(--card-rgb, var(--accent-rgb)), 0.55);
  background: rgba(var(--card-rgb, var(--accent-rgb)), 0.2);
  color: var(--text);
}

.card-download:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.card-download:disabled {
  cursor: wait;
}

.card-download svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.card-download.is-busy svg {
  display: none;
}

.card-download.is-busy::after {
  content: '';
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-top-color: var(--text);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

.card-title {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.35;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  transition: color 0.16s ease;
}

.game-card:hover .card-title {
  color: var(--text);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- Skeletons */

.skeleton-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 9px;
}

.skeleton-art {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--panel);
}

.skeleton-line {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 74%;
  height: 12px;
  margin-top: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--panel);
}

.skeleton-art::after,
.skeleton-line::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055) 55%, transparent 90%);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: shimmer 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  to {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- State panels */

.state-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 580px;
  margin: 40px auto 0;
  padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 48px) 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24, 19, 21, 0.78), rgba(11, 9, 10, 0.78));
  text-align: center;
}

.state-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 21px;
}

.state-panel h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 21px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.state-panel p {
  max-width: 460px;
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.state-panel .btn {
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.state-panel .state-hint {
  margin-top: 22px;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 11.5px;
}

.state-empty {
  padding-top: 44px;
  padding-bottom: 44px;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- Buttons */

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease;
}

.btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px);
}

.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-ink);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--accent-hover);
}

.btn-quiet {
  border-color: var(--border);
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text-soft);
}

.btn-quiet:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
}

.btn-small {
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.btn-icon {
  width: 40px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 0;
}

.btn-icon[aria-pressed="true"] {
  border-color: rgba(var(--player-accent-rgb), 0.45);
  background: rgba(var(--player-accent-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--text);
}

.btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.load-more-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 34px;
}

.load-more {
  min-width: 190px;
  min-height: 42px;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- Footer */

.footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px var(--gutter) 34px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 11.5px;
}

.footer p {
  margin: 0;
}

.footer-muted {
  text-align: right;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- Player */

.player {
  --player-accent: var(--accent);
  --player-accent-rgb: var(--accent-rgb);
  --player-accent-ink: var(--accent-ink);

  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: #000;
  animation: player-in 0.16s ease-out;
}

.player[data-source="gn-math"] {
  --player-accent: var(--source-gn-math);
  --player-accent-rgb: var(--source-gn-math-rgb);
  --player-accent-ink: #220206;
}

.player[data-source="lumin"] {
  --player-accent: var(--source-lumin);
  --player-accent-rgb: var(--source-lumin-rgb);
  --player-accent-ink: #03201d;
}

.player[data-source="noahs-tutoring"] {
  --player-accent: var(--source-noahs-tutoring);
  --player-accent-rgb: var(--source-noahs-tutoring-rgb);
  --player-accent-ink: #221400;
}

.player:fullscreen {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  inset: 0;
}

/* True fullscreen is the game and nothing else. Escape restores the toolbar. */
.player:fullscreen .player-bar {
  display: none;
}

/* The SVG wrapper expands the whole app when native iframe fullscreen is
   unavailable (for example when the file is opened from disk). */
body.is-fullscreen .player-bar {
  display: none;
}

.player::backdrop {
  background: #000;
}

#fullscreen-game .icon-compress {
  display: none;
}

#fullscreen-game[aria-pressed="true"] .icon-expand {
  display: none;
}

#fullscreen-game[aria-pressed="true"] .icon-compress {
  display: block;
}

@keyframes player-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.player-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: var(--bar-height);
  padding: 8px 12px 8px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(var(--player-accent-rgb), 0.16);
  background: #0a0809;
}

.player-identity {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.player-identity > .source-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
}

.player-heading {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.player-title {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-width: min(52vw, 720px);
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.player-source {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--player-accent);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.player-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.btn-reload {
  min-height: 36px;
  background: transparent;
}

.btn-close {
  min-height: 36px;
  border-color: rgba(var(--player-accent-rgb), 0.45);
  background: var(--player-accent);
  color: var(--player-accent-ink);
}

.btn-close:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
}

.player-stage {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  background: #000;
}

#game-frame {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  background: #000;
}

.frame-status {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  background: #000;
}

.status-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  max-width: 460px;
  text-align: center;
}

.status-card p {
  margin: 16px 0 0;
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.status-card .status-hint {
  margin-top: 7px;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.status-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.spinner {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-top-color: var(--player-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.noscript {
  position: fixed;
  inset: auto 16px 16px;
  z-index: 400;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.toast {
  position: fixed;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: 24px;
  z-index: 500;
  max-width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  padding: 10px 15px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: center;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  animation: toast-in 0.18s ease-out;
}

.toast[data-tone="error"] {
  border-color: rgba(255, 92, 107, 0.5);
  color: #ffc7cd;
}

@keyframes toast-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, 8px);
  }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------- Custom accent + settings */

/* A custom accent from Settings overrides every per-source theme. */
body.theme-locked .filter[data-source].is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.42);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.09);
}

body.theme-locked .filter[data-source].is-active .filter-count {
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.16);
  color: var(--accent);
}

body.theme-locked .player[data-source] {
  --player-accent: var(--accent);
  --player-accent-rgb: var(--accent-rgb);
  --player-accent-ink: var(--accent-ink);
}

.settings {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 320;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
}

.settings-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.settings-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(480px, 100%);
  max-height: min(92vh, 780px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background:
    radial-gradient(520px 280px at 100% -10%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.12), transparent 65%),
    var(--panel);
  box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  animation: settings-in 0.18s ease-out;
}

@keyframes settings-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.985);
  }
}

.settings-head {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 20px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel);
}

.settings-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

#settings-title {
  margin: 5px 0 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 820;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.settings-close {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--muted);
}

.settings-close:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
}

.settings-close svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.settings-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 18px 20px 20px;
}

.settings-group {
  padding: 15px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015);
}

.settings-group h3 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.settings-help {
  margin: 6px 0 12px;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.cloak-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.cloak-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 650;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.cloak-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
}

.cloak-option.is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.55);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.11);
  color: var(--text);
}

.cloak-option img {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.cloak-off {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.color-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.color-control {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 5px 11px 5px 5px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.color-control:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.color-control input[type="color"] {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.color-control input[type="color"]::-webkit-color-swatch-wrapper {
  padding: 0;
}

.color-control input[type="color"]::-webkit-color-swatch {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.color-value {
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

.settings-note {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  color: var(--muted-2);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.bg-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.bg-option {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 7px 9px 7px 7px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--panel-2);
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 650;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease;
}

.bg-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  background: var(--panel-3);
  color: var(--text);
}

.bg-option:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.bg-option.is-active {
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.55);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.11);
  color: var(--text);
}

.bg-swatch {
  width: 42px;
  height: 30px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background-color: #060506;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

.bg-swatch-embers {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(28px 22px at 78% 0%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.78), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(24px 20px at 10% 72%, rgba(var(--accent-deep-rgb), 0.9), transparent 70%);
}

.bg-swatch-grid {
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.28) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.28) 1px, transparent 1px),
    radial-gradient(30px 18px at 50% 100%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.55), transparent 70%);
  background-size: 8px 8px, 8px 8px, auto;
}

.bg-swatch-fog {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(26px 20px at 26% 22%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.72), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(24px 18px at 80% 80%, rgba(103, 136, 166, 0.7), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(155deg, #0a0c10, #050607);
}

.bg-swatch-midnight {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 22% 30%, #fff, transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 68% 62%, rgba(255, 238, 240, 0.8), transparent),
    radial-gradient(1px 1px at 38% 82%, rgba(174, 190, 255, 0.8), transparent),
    radial-gradient(22px 18px at 82% 0%, rgba(92, 86, 214, 0.5), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(165deg, #090d20, #04050d);
}

.bg-image-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 13px;
}

.bg-image-label {
  color: var(--text-soft);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.bg-image-field input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 12px;
}

.bg-image-field input::placeholder {
  color: var(--muted-2);
}

.bg-image-field input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), 0.12);
}

.bg-image-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.settings-wide {
  width: 100%;
}

.settings-status {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 92, 107, 0.4);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 92, 107, 0.08);
  color: var(--danger);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.settings-footer {
  display: flex;
  padding-top: 2px;
}

.settings-github {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
}

.settings-github svg {
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  fill: currentColor;
  stroke: none;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Responsive */

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .intro {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 28px;
  }

  .stats {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .stat {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .featured-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .featured-card.is-hero {
    grid-row: auto;
  }

  .featured-card.is-hero .card-open {
    flex: none;
  }

  .featured-card.is-hero .card-art {
    flex: none;
    min-height: 0;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  }

  .featured-card.is-hero .card-art.is-portrait {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .game-card,
  .card-open {
    scroll-margin-top: 132px;
  }

  .card-download {
    top: 6px;
    right: 6px;
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
  }

  .filters {
    /* Wrap instead of hiding the newer sources off the right edge. */
    width: 100%;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    overflow-x: visible;
  }

  :root {
    --gutter: 16px;
    --bar-height: 54px;
  }

  .topbar-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    min-height: 0;
    padding-top: 12px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .brand-mark {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .brand-name {
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .brand-tag {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .topbar-actions {
    order: 2;
    width: 100%;
    flex: 1 1 100%;
  }

  .search-field {
    order: 0;
    width: auto;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    max-width: none;
  }

  .settings-button {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
  }

  #search {
    height: 42px;
  }

  .search-hint {
    display: none;
  }

  #search {
    padding-right: 14px;
  }

  .intro {
    padding-top: 32px;
    padding-bottom: 26px;
  }

  .intro h1 {
    font-size: clamp(34px, 10vw, 44px);
  }

  .lede {
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .stats {
    display: none;
  }

  .featured {
    padding-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .featured-head {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .featured-grid {
    gap: 16px 12px;
  }

  .featured-card.is-hero .card-title {
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  .catalog-bar {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .result-count {
    order: -1;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .game-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: 18px 12px;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }

  .card-source {
    top: 6px;
    left: 6px;
    padding: 3px 6px;
    font-size: 8px;
  }

  .notice {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .notice-text {
    flex-basis: calc(100% - 38px);
  }

  .notice .btn {
    margin-left: 34px;
  }

  .footer {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 5px;
    padding-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .footer-muted {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .player-bar {
    gap: 10px;
    padding-left: 12px;
  }

  .player-title {
    max-width: 42vw;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .player-source {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .btn-reload,
  .btn-close {
    min-height: 34px;
    padding: 0 11px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .player-actions {
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .player-actions .btn {
    width: 36px;
    min-height: 36px;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .btn-reload span,
  .btn-close span {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .game-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .player-bar {
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 8px 6px 10px;
  }

  .player-title {
    max-width: 32vw;
  }

  .player-actions .btn {
    width: 34px;
    min-height: 34px;
  }

  .btn-reload,
  .btn-close {
    min-height: 34px;
    padding: 0 9px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}
</style>

<!--
  Source for the portable SVG shell. build-svg.py embeds this same script,
  and the Download SVG button reads it when rebuilding the SVG in the browser
  (for example when index.html is opened directly from disk).
-->
<script type="text/plain" id="portable-wrapper">
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const iframe = document.getElementById('app');
  const source = document.getElementById('app-source');
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('doc-title');
  const iconEl = document.getElementById('top-icon');
  const DEFAULT_TITLE = 'Ghoulish';
  const DEFAULT_ICON = iconEl.getAttribute('href') || '';

  let lastTitle = '';
  let lastIcon = '';

  function sync() {
    let doc = null;
    try {
      doc = iframe.contentDocument;
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (!doc) return;

    const nextTitle = doc.title || DEFAULT_TITLE;
    if (nextTitle !== lastTitle) {
      lastTitle = nextTitle;
      titleEl.textContent = nextTitle;
    }

    const innerIcon = doc.getElementById('favicon');
    const nextIcon = innerIcon && innerIcon.getAttribute('href');
    if (nextIcon && nextIcon !== lastIcon) {
      lastIcon = nextIcon;
      iconEl.setAttribute('href', nextIcon);
    }
  }

  // Settings asks the outer document for its own source, so saving the SVG
  // produces the complete portable site instead of rebuilding it in the app.
  window.__GHOULISH_EXPORT_SVG__ = () => {
    const clone = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
    const frameClone = clone.querySelector('#app');
    if (frameClone) {
      frameClone.removeAttribute('srcdoc');
      frameClone.removeAttribute('src');
    }

    const cloneTitle = clone.querySelector('#doc-title');
    if (cloneTitle) cloneTitle.textContent = DEFAULT_TITLE;

    const cloneIcon = clone.querySelector('#top-icon');
    if (cloneIcon && DEFAULT_ICON) cloneIcon.setAttribute('href', DEFAULT_ICON);

    const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone);
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n${xml}`;
  };

  // Opened from disk, browsers disable the Fullscreen API in the embedded
  // document. Let the app ask this top-level SVG document for fullscreen
  // instead; it has the same visual result and keeps Escape working.
  window.__GHOULISH_TOP_FULLSCREEN__ = {
    get enabled() {
      return Boolean(document.fullscreenEnabled);
    },
    isActive() {
      return Boolean(document.fullscreenElement);
    },
    enter() {
      const root = document.documentElement;
      if (!root || typeof root.requestFullscreen !== 'function') {
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Fullscreen is unavailable'));
      }
      return root.requestFullscreen();
    },
    exit() {
      if (!document.fullscreenElement) return Promise.resolve();
      return document.exitFullscreen();
    },
  };

  function notifyFullscreen() {
    sync();
    try {
      const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
      if (doc) {
        doc.dispatchEvent(new doc.defaultView.Event('ghoulish:top-fullscreen-change'));
      }
    } catch {
      // The app may still be loading.
    }
  }

  let observer = null;

  function observeApp() {
    try {
      const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
      if (!doc || !doc.head) return;
      if (observer) observer.disconnect();
      observer = new MutationObserver(sync);
      observer.observe(doc.head, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true,
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['href'],
      });
      sync();
    } catch {
      // Cross-origin embeds fall back to the interval below.
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', notifyFullscreen);
  iframe.addEventListener('load', observeApp);
  iframe.srcdoc = source.textContent;
  setInterval(sync, 1000);
})();
</script>
</head>
<body data-theme="all">
  <a class="skip-link" href="#catalog">Skip to catalog</a>

  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="topbar-inner">
      <a class="brand" href="#" aria-label="Ghoulish home">
        <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="64" height="64" focusable="false">
            <rect width="64" height="64" rx="12" fill="#0a0a0a"></rect>
            <rect class="brand-frame" x="7" y="11" width="50" height="38" rx="7"></rect>
            <rect x="12" y="16" width="40" height="28" rx="3" fill="#0a0a0a"></rect>
            <circle class="brand-person" cx="32" cy="27" r="6"></circle>
            <path class="brand-person" d="M20 44 C20 36 26 34 32 34 C38 34 44 36 44 44 Z"></path>
            <circle cx="46" cy="46" r="15" fill="#0a0a0a"></circle>
            <path class="brand-letter" d="M52.6 41.4 A8 8 0 1 0 54 46 L47 46" fill="none" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
          </svg>
        </span>
        <span class="brand-copy">
          <span class="brand-name">Ghoulish</span>
          <span class="brand-tag">Made By Ghoul</span>
        </span>
      </a>

      <div class="topbar-actions">
        <div class="search-field">
          <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle>
            <path d="m20 20-3.6-3.6"></path>
          </svg>
          <label class="sr-only" for="search">Search games by title</label>
          <input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Search games…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="search">
          <kbd class="search-hint" aria-hidden="true">/</kbd>
        </div>

        <button type="button" class="settings-button" id="open-settings" aria-label="Settings" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="settings" title="Settings">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.1"></circle>
            <path d="M19.4 15a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34 1.88l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.88-.34 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1 1.56V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.11-1.56 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.88.34l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 .34-1.88 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.56-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.56-1.11 1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34-1.88l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.88.34H9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1-1.56V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1 1.56 1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.88-.34l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-.34 1.88V9a1.7 1.7 0 0 0 1.56 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.1a1.7 1.7 0 0 0-1.5 1Z"></path>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main id="catalog" class="page">
    <section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
      <div class="intro-copy">
        <p class="eyebrow"><span class="live-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span> Three libraries One Site.</p>
        <h1 id="intro-title">GHOULISH<br><span>Have Fun</span></h1>
        <p class="lede">videcoded most of ts</p>
      </div>

      <div class="stats" aria-label="Catalog statistics">
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-value" id="stat-games">—</span>
          <span class="stat-label">games</span>
        </div>
        <div class="stat">
          <span class="stat-value" id="stat-sources">—</span>
          <span class="stat-label">libraries</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="featured" id="featured" aria-labelledby="featured-title" hidden="">
      <div class="featured-head">
        <h2 class="featured-title" id="featured-title">Featured games</h2>
        <p class="featured-note">Hand-picked highlights</p>
      </div>
      <div class="featured-grid" id="featured-grid"></div>
    </section>

    <div class="catalog-bar">
      <div class="filters" id="filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter by source">
        <button type="button" class="filter is-active" data-source="all" aria-pressed="true">
          All <span class="filter-count" id="count-all">—</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="filter" data-source="gn-math" aria-pressed="false">
          <span class="source-dot source-gn-math" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          GN-Math <span class="filter-count" id="count-gn-math">—</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="filter" data-source="lumin" aria-pressed="false">
          <span class="source-dot source-lumin" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          Lumin <span class="filter-count" id="count-lumin">—</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="filter" data-source="noahs-tutoring" aria-pressed="false">
          <span class="source-dot source-noahs-tutoring" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          Noah’s Tutoring <span class="filter-count" id="count-noahs-tutoring">—</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <p class="result-count" id="result-count" aria-live="polite">Loading libraries…</p>
    </div>

    <div class="notice" id="notice" role="status" hidden="">
      <span class="notice-mark" aria-hidden="true">!</span>
      <p class="notice-text" id="notice-text"></p>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-small btn-quiet" id="notice-retry">Retry</button>
    </div>

    <section class="catalog" aria-label="Game catalog">
      <div class="game-grid" id="grid" aria-busy="true"></div>

      <div class="state-panel" id="error-state" role="alert" hidden="">
        <span class="state-icon" aria-hidden="true">⚠</span>
        <h2>The catalog didn’t load</h2>
        <p id="error-message">All game sources could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.</p>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="error-retry">Try again</button>
        <p class="state-hint">Blocked by an extension, firewall, or strict network? See the troubleshooting notes in the README.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="state-panel state-empty" id="empty-state" hidden="">
        <span class="state-icon" aria-hidden="true">◌</span>
        <h2 id="empty-title">No games found</h2>
        <p id="empty-message">Try a shorter search or switch back to all sources.</p>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet" id="clear-filters">Clear filters</button>
      </div>

      <div class="load-more-wrap" id="load-more-wrap" hidden="">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet load-more" id="load-more">Show more games</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="footer">
    <p>Ghoulish · the worst website ever</p>
    <p class="footer-muted">Games are hosted by OTHER people NOT me</p>
  </footer>

  <!-- Settings: cloak, accent, and about:blank controls. -->
  <section class="settings" id="settings" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="settings-title" hidden="">
    <div class="settings-backdrop" data-settings-close=""></div>

    <div class="settings-panel">
      <header class="settings-head">
        <div>
          <p class="settings-title">Settings</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="settings-close" id="settings-close" data-settings-close="" aria-label="Close settings">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"></path>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </header>

      <div class="settings-body">
        <section class="settings-group" aria-labelledby="settings-cloak-label">
          <h3 id="settings-cloak-label">Cloak</h3>
          <p class="settings-help">Disguise the tab as a Google page. The title and favicon change until you turn the cloak off.</p>
          <div class="cloak-options" id="cloak-options" role="group" aria-label="Cloak page as">
            <button type="button" class="cloak-option is-active" data-cloak="off" aria-pressed="true">
              <span class="cloak-off" aria-hidden="true">✕</span>
              Off
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="cloak-option" data-cloak="classroom" aria-pressed="false">
              <img src="https://ssl.gstatic.com/classroom/favicon.png" alt="" width="16" height="16" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
              Classroom
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="cloak-option" data-cloak="drive" aria-pressed="false">
              <img src="https://ssl.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/drive_2020q4_32dp.png" alt="" width="16" height="16" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
              Drive
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="cloak-option" data-cloak="google" aria-pressed="false">
              <img src="https://www.google.com/favicon.ico" alt="" width="16" height="16" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">
              Google
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="settings-group" aria-labelledby="settings-color-label">
          <h3 id="settings-color-label">Secondary color</h3>
          <p class="settings-help">Choose the accent used across the page. A custom color stays put when you switch libraries.</p>
          <div class="color-row">
            <label class="color-control" for="accent-color">
              <input type="color" id="accent-color" value="#ff3b4e" aria-label="Secondary color">
              <span class="color-value" id="accent-value">#FF3B4E</span>
            </label>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet btn-small" id="accent-reset" disabled="">Use page themes</button>
          </div>
          <p class="settings-note" id="accent-note">Pick a color to lock every library to the same accent.</p>
        </section>

        <section class="settings-group" aria-labelledby="settings-bg-label">
          <h3 id="settings-bg-label">Background</h3>
          <p class="settings-help">Pick a preset or use your own image. Presets follow the active color, and custom images are dimmed so the catalog stays readable.</p>
          <div class="bg-options" id="bg-options" role="group" aria-label="Background design">
            <button type="button" class="bg-option is-active" data-bg="embers" aria-pressed="true">
              <span class="bg-swatch bg-swatch-embers" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              Embers
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="bg-option" data-bg="grid" aria-pressed="false">
              <span class="bg-swatch bg-swatch-grid" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              Grid
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="bg-option" data-bg="fog" aria-pressed="false">
              <span class="bg-swatch bg-swatch-fog" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              Fog
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="bg-option" data-bg="midnight" aria-pressed="false">
              <span class="bg-swatch bg-swatch-midnight" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              Midnight
            </button>
          </div>
          <label class="bg-image-field" for="bg-image-url">
            <span class="bg-image-label">Image URL</span>
            <input type="url" id="bg-image-url" placeholder="https://example.com/background.jpg" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" inputmode="url">
          </label>
          <div class="bg-image-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet btn-small" id="bg-image-apply">Use image</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet btn-small" id="bg-image-clear" hidden="">Remove image</button>
          </div>
          <p class="settings-note" id="bg-note">Choose a preset, or paste a direct image URL.</p>
        </section>

        <section class="settings-group" aria-labelledby="settings-window-label">
          <h3 id="settings-window-label">Window</h3>
          <p class="settings-help">Open a clean copy of Ghoulish in a new tab whose address stays about:blank.</p>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary settings-wide" id="open-in-blank">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M14 4h6v6"></path>
              <path d="M20 4 10 14"></path>
              <path d="M19 14v5a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5"></path>
            </svg>
            Open in about:blank
          </button>
        </section>

        <section class="settings-group" aria-labelledby="settings-file-label">
          <h3 id="settings-file-label">Portable file</h3>
          <p class="settings-help">Save the whole site as one SVG file you can open in any browser. Games still need an internet connection.</p>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-quiet settings-wide" id="download-svg">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M12 3v12"></path>
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"></path>
              <path d="M4 21h16"></path>
            </svg>
            Download SVG
          </button>

/** Apply the same cleanup rules used by the Sigma Games GN-Math page. */
function isRealGame(zone) {
  if (!zone || !zone.name || !zone.url) return false;

  const name = String(zone.name).trim().toLowerCase();
  const url = String(zone.url).trim().toLowerCase();

  if (name.startsWith('[!]') || name.includes('[!]') || name.startsWith('[?')) return false;
  if (
    name.includes('comment') ||
    name.includes('discord') ||
    name.includes('suggest game') ||
    name.includes('suggest a game')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (

    url.includes('forms.gle') ||
    url.includes('docs.google.com/forms')

    return url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'https:';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }

/**

    const thumbnail = expandUrl(zone.cover, COVER_BASE);
    const playUrl = expandUrl(zone.url, HTML_BASE);

}

/** Fetch the catalog text with a timeout, trying the primary URL then a mirror. */
async function fetchCatalogText() {
  let lastError;

  for (const url of [CATALOG_URL, CATALOG_FALLBACK_URL]) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        signal: controller.signal,
        credentials: 'omit',

/** Convert the upstream object literal into parseable JSON and return its entries. */
function parseCatalog(text) {
  const start = text.indexOf('[');
  const end = text.lastIndexOf(']');

  if (start === -1 || end <= start) {
    throw new Error('Unexpected catalog shape');
  }

  const literal = text
    .slice(start, end + 1)
    .replace(/([{,]\s*)([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*:/g, '$1"$2":')
    .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, '$1');

  let data;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(literal);

    throw new Error('Could not parse the Noah’s Tutoring catalog');
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Unexpected catalog shape');
  }

  return data;
}

function slugify(value) {

    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')

    if (base) return base;
  } catch {
    // Fall through to the slug.
  }

}
