  fullscreenGame: document.getElementById('fullscreen-game'),
  frame: document.getElementById('game-frame'),
  frameStatus: document.getElementById('frame-status'),
  toast: document.getElementById('toast'),
  catalog: document.getElementById('catalog'),
  topbar: document.querySelector('.topbar'),
  footer: document.querySelector('.footer'),
  skipLink: document.querySelector('.skip-link'),
  favicon: document.getElementById('favicon'),
  openSettings: document.getElementById('open-settings'),
  settings: document.getElementById('settings'),
  settingsClose: document.getElementById('settings-close'),
  settingsStatus: document.getElementById('settings-status'),
  cloakOptions: document.getElementById('cloak-options'),
  accentColor: document.getElementById('accent-color'),
  accentValue: document.getElementById('accent-value'),
  accentReset: document.getElementById('accent-reset'),
  accentNote: document.getElementById('accent-note'),
  bgOptions: document.getElementById('bg-options'),
  bgImageUrl: document.getElementById('bg-image-url'),
  bgImageApply: document.getElementById('bg-image-apply'),
  bgImageClear: document.getElementById('bg-image-clear'),
  bgNote: document.getElementById('bg-note'),
  openInBlank: document.getElementById('open-in-blank'),
  downloadSvg: document.getElementById('download-svg'),
};

const state = {
  games: [],
  byId: new Map(),
  query: '',
  source: 'all',
  visible: BATCH_SIZE,
  rendered: 0,
  status: new Map(),
  loaded: false,
  current: null,
  lastFocused: null,
  framePhase: 'idle',
  frameToken: 0,
  frameHideTimer: 0,
  preparedHtml: '',
  featured: [],
  fullscreenExitedAt: 0,
  cloak: 'off',
  customAccent: null,
  bgDesign: 'embers',
  bgImage: '',
  settingsOpen: false,
  lastSettingsFocus: null,
};

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Startup */

els.catalog.hidden = false;
els.footer.hidden = false;

initSettings();
initFullscreen();
wireEvents();
showSkeletons();
loadCatalog();

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- Events */

function wireEvents() {
  els.search.addEventListener('input', () => {
    state.query = els.search.value;
    resetAndRender();
  });

  els.filters.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-source]');
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
    state.source = button.dataset.source;
    resetAndRender();
  });

  els.grid.addEventListener('click', handleCardClick);
  els.featuredGrid.addEventListener('click', handleCardClick);

  els.loadMore.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible += BATCH_SIZE;
    renderResults({ reset: false });
  });

  els.errorRetry.addEventListener('click', loadCatalog);
  els.noticeRetry.addEventListener('click', loadCatalog);

  els.clearFilters.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.query = '';
    state.source = 'all';
    els.search.value = '';
    resetAndRender();
    els.search.focus();
  });

  els.closeGame.addEventListener('click', closePlayer);
  els.reloadGame.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.current) loadGameFrame(state.current);
  });
  els.downloadGame.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.current) downloadGame(state.current, els.downloadGame);
  });
  els.fullscreenGame.addEventListener('click', toggleFullscreen);
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleFullscreenChange);

  els.frame.addEventListener('load', () => {
    if (state.framePhase === 'ready') {
      clearTimeout(state.frameHideTimer);
      els.frameStatus.hidden = true;
    }
  });

  els.openSettings.addEventListener('click', openSettings);
  els.settings.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-settings-close]')) closeSettings();
  });

  els.cloakOptions.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-cloak]');
    if (!button) return;
    applyCloak(button.dataset.cloak);
    saveSettings();
  });

  els.accentColor.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (applyCustomAccent(els.accentColor.value)) saveSettings();
  });

  els.accentReset.addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearCustomAccent();
    saveSettings();
  });

  els.bgOptions.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-bg]');
    if (!button) return;
    applyBackgroundPreset(button.dataset.bg);
    saveSettings();
  });

  els.bgImageApply.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (applyBackgroundImage(els.bgImageUrl.value)) saveSettings();
  });

  els.bgImageUrl.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key !== 'Enter') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (applyBackgroundImage(els.bgImageUrl.value)) saveSettings();
  });

  els.bgImageUrl.addEventListener('input', () => setSettingsStatus(''));

  els.bgImageClear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearBackgroundImage();
    saveSettings();
  });

  els.openInBlank.addEventListener('click', openInBlank);
  els.downloadSvg.addEventListener('click', () => downloadSvg(els.downloadSvg));

  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleGlobalKeydown);
}

function handleCardClick(event) {
  const download = event.target.closest('.card-download');
  if (download) {
    const game = getGameById(download.dataset.downloadGame);
    if (game) downloadGame(game, download);
    return;
  }

  const opener = event.target.closest('.card-open');
  if (!opener) return;
  const card = opener.closest('.game-card');
  const game = card ? getGameById(card.dataset.gameId) : null;
  if (game) openGame(game, opener);
}

function getGameById(id) {
  return state.byId.get(id) || state.featured.find((game) => game.id === id) || null;
}

function handleGlobalKeydown(event) {
  const typing = isTypingTarget(event.target);

  if (event.key === '/' && !typing && els.player.hidden && !state.settingsOpen) {
    event.preventDefault();
    els.search.focus();
    return;
  }

  if (event.key === 'Escape') {
    if (state.settingsOpen) {
      event.preventDefault();
      closeSettings();
      return;
    }

    if (!els.player.hidden) {
      // The first Escape leaves browser fullscreen; the next one closes the player.
      if (isFullscreenActive()) {
        const wrapper = getWrapperFullscreen();
        if (wrapper) wrapper.exit().catch(() => {});
        return;
      }
      if (Date.now() - state.fullscreenExitedAt < 350) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      closePlayer();
    } else if (document.activeElement === els.search) {
      els.search.blur();
    }
  }

  // Keep keyboard focus inside whichever overlay is open.
  if (event.key === 'Tab') {
    if (state.settingsOpen) {
      trapFocus(els.settings, event);
    } else if (!els.player.hidden) {
      trapFocus(els.player, event);
    }
  }
}

function trapFocus(container, event) {
  const focusable = Array.from(
    container.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), a[href], input:not([disabled]), iframe')
  ).filter((element) => element.offsetParent !== null || element === els.frame);

  if (focusable.length === 0) return;
  const first = focusable[0];
  const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

  if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
    event.preventDefault();
    last.focus();
  } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
    event.preventDefault();
    first.focus();
  }
}

function isTypingTarget(target) {
  if (!target || !(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = target.tagName;
  return tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || tag === 'SELECT' || target.isContentEditable;
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- Catalog */

async function loadCatalog() {
  state.loaded = false;
  state.games = [];
  state.byId.clear();
  state.rendered = 0;
  state.visible = BATCH_SIZE;
  state.status = new Map(SOURCES.map((source) => [source.id, { state: 'loading' }]));

  els.notice.hidden = true;
  els.errorState.hidden = true;
  els.emptyState.hidden = true;
  els.loadMoreWrap.hidden = true;
  els.grid.hidden = false;
  els.grid.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
  els.resultCount.textContent = 'Loading libraries…';
  els.statGames.textContent = '—';
  els.statSources.textContent = '—';
  setFilterCounts();
  updateFilterButtons();
  showSkeletons();

  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    SOURCES.map((source) => LOADERS.get(source.id)())
  );

  const games = [];
  const failures = [];

  results.forEach((result, index) => {
    const source = SOURCES[index];

    if (result.status === 'fulfilled') {
      state.status.set(source.id, { state: 'ready', count: result.value.length });
      games.push(...result.value);
    } else {
      state.status.set(source.id, { state: 'error', error: result.reason });
      failures.push({ source, error: result.reason });
      console.error(`[Ghoulish] ${source.label} failed to load:`, result.reason);
    }
  });

  state.loaded = true;
  state.games = sortGames(games);
  state.byId = new Map(state.games.map((game) => [game.id, game]));
  state.rendered = 0;
  state.visible = BATCH_SIZE;

  updateStats();
  setFilterCounts();
  updateFilterButtons();
  renderFeatured();

  if (failures.length === SOURCES.length) {
    showCatalogError();
    return;
  }

  els.grid.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    showPartialNotice(failures);
  }

  renderResults({ reset: true });
}

function sortGames(games) {
  return games.sort((a, b) =>
    a.title.localeCompare(b.title, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
  );
}

function getFilteredGames() {
  const terms = state.query
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);

  return state.games.filter((game) => {
    if (state.source !== 'all' && game.source !== state.source) return false;
    if (terms.length === 0) return true;

    const title = game.title.toLowerCase();
    return terms.every((term) => title.includes(term));
  });
}

function resetAndRender() {
  state.visible = BATCH_SIZE;
  state.rendered = 0;
  updateFilterButtons();
  renderResults({ reset: true });
}

function renderResults({ reset }) {
  const filtered = getFilteredGames();

  if (reset) {
    state.rendered = 0;
    els.grid.replaceChildren();
  }

  const end = Math.min(state.visible, filtered.length);
  if (end > state.rendered) {
    appendCards(filtered.slice(state.rendered, end));
    state.rendered = end;
  }

  els.grid.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
  els.grid.hidden = filtered.length === 0;
  els.emptyState.hidden = filtered.length !== 0;
  els.loadMoreWrap.hidden = filtered.length <= state.rendered;
  els.loadMore.textContent = `Show more (${formatNumber(
    Math.max(filtered.length - state.rendered, 0)
  )} remaining)`;

  updateResultCount(filtered);
  updateFeaturedVisibility();

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    updateEmptyState();
  }
}

function appendCards(games) {
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  for (const game of games) {
    fragment.append(createCard(game));
  }
  els.grid.append(fragment);
}

function renderFeatured() {
  const picks = [SKATE_GAME];

  if (state.games.length > 0) {
    picks.push(
      ...pickRandomFeatured(
        FEATURED_COUNT - picks.length,
        new Set([normalizeTitle(SKATE_GAME.title)])
      )
    );
  }

  state.featured = picks;
  els.featuredGrid.replaceChildren();

  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  picks.forEach((game, index) => {
    const card = createCard(game);
    card.classList.add('featured-card');

    if (index === 0) {
      card.classList.add('is-hero');

      if (game.portrait) {
        const art = card.querySelector('.card-art');
        art.classList.add('is-portrait');
        art.style.setProperty('--hero-cover', `url("${game.thumbnail}")`);
      }
    }

    fragment.append(card);
  });

  els.featuredGrid.append(fragment);
  updateFeaturedVisibility();
}

/** Draw distinct random catalog games, preferring entries that have cover art. */
function pickRandomFeatured(count, excludedTitles) {
  const seen = new Set(excludedTitles);
  const pool = state.games.filter(
    (game) => game.thumbnail && !seen.has(normalizeTitle(game.title))
  );
  const picks = [];

  for (let index = 0; index < pool.length && picks.length < count; index += 1) {
    const swapWith = index + Math.floor(Math.random() * (pool.length - index));
    [pool[index], pool[swapWith]] = [pool[swapWith], pool[index]];

    const game = pool[index];
    const key = normalizeTitle(game.title);
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;

    seen.add(key);
    picks.push(game);
  }

  return picks;
}

function normalizeTitle(value) {
  return String(value).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '');
}

function updateFeaturedVisibility() {
  const browsingAll = state.source === 'all' && !state.query.trim();
  els.featured.hidden = !browsingAll || state.featured.length === 0;
}

function createCard(game) {
  const source = SOURCE_BY_ID.get(game.source);
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'game-card';
  card.dataset.gameId = game.id;
  card.dataset.source = game.source;

  const open = document.createElement('button');
  open.type = 'button';
  open.className = 'card-open';
  open.setAttribute(
    'aria-label',
    `Play ${game.title}${game.author ? ` by ${game.author}` : source ? ` from ${source.label}` : ''}`
  );

  const art = document.createElement('span');
  art.className = 'card-art';
  art.dataset.initial = getInitials(game.title);
  art.style.setProperty('--hue', String(hueFor(game)));

  if (game.thumbnail) {
    const image = document.createElement('img');
    image.alt = '';
    image.loading = 'lazy';
    image.decoding = 'async';
    image.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';
    image.addEventListener(
      'error',
      () => {
        art.classList.add('is-fallback');
        image.remove();
      },
      { once: true }
    );
    image.src = game.thumbnail;
    art.append(image);
  } else {
    art.classList.add('is-fallback');
  }

  if (source) {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'card-source';
    badge.dataset.source = game.source;

    if (game.author) {
      badge.classList.add('card-author');
      badge.textContent = game.author;
    } else {
      const dot = document.createElement('span');
      dot.className = `source-dot source-${game.source}`;
      dot.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

      badge.append(dot, document.createTextNode(source.label));
    }

    art.append(badge);
  }

  const title = document.createElement('span');
  title.className = 'card-title';
  title.textContent = game.title;
  open.append(art, title);

  const download = document.createElement('button');
  download.type = 'button';
  download.className = 'card-download';
  download.dataset.downloadGame = game.id;
  download.setAttribute('aria-label', `Download ${game.title} as an HTML file`);
  download.title = 'Download HTML';
  download.innerHTML =
    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12"></path><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"></path><path d="M4 21h16"></path></svg>';

  card.append(open, download);
  return card;
}

function showSkeletons() {
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();

  for (let index = 0; index < 12; index += 1) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'skeleton-card';
    card.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    const art = document.createElement('div');
    art.className = 'skeleton-art';

    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'skeleton-line';

    card.append(art, line);
    fragment.append(card);
  }

  els.grid.replaceChildren(fragment);
  els.grid.hidden = false;
}

function updateStats() {
  const readySources = SOURCES.filter(
    (source) => state.status.get(source.id)?.state === 'ready'
  ).length;

  els.statGames.textContent = state.loaded ? formatNumber(state.games.length) : '—';
  els.statSources.textContent = state.loaded ? String(readySources) : '—';
}

function setFilterCounts() {
  const counts = new Map(SOURCES.map((source) => [source.id, 0]));
  for (const game of state.games) {
    counts.set(game.source, (counts.get(game.source) || 0) + 1);
  }

  els.countAll.textContent = state.loaded ? formatNumber(state.games.length) : '—';
  els.countGnMath.textContent = state.loaded ? formatNumber(counts.get(GN_MATH.id) || 0) : '—';
  els.countLumin.textContent = state.loaded ? formatNumber(counts.get(LUMIN.id) || 0) : '—';
  els.countNoahsTutoring.textContent = state.loaded
    ? formatNumber(counts.get(NOAHS_TUTORING.id) || 0)
    : '—';

  for (const button of els.filters.querySelectorAll('[data-source]')) {
    const source = button.dataset.source;
    if (source === 'all') continue;

    const status = state.status.get(source);
    const count = counts.get(source) || 0;
    const unavailable = state.loaded && status?.state === 'error' && count === 0;
    button.disabled = unavailable;
    button.title = unavailable ? `${SOURCE_BY_ID.get(source)?.label} could not be loaded` : '';
  }
}

function updateFilterButtons() {
  for (const button of els.filters.querySelectorAll('[data-source]')) {
    const active = button.dataset.source === state.source;
    button.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  }

  // The shell follows the selected library: red for All, crimson for GN-Math,
  // teal for Lumin, and amber for Noah's Tutoring. A custom accent from
  // Settings locks the shell to that color instead.
  document.body.dataset.theme = state.customAccent ? 'all' : state.source;
  document.body.classList.toggle('theme-locked', Boolean(state.customAccent));
}

function updateResultCount(filtered) {
  if (!state.loaded) {
    els.resultCount.textContent = 'Loading libraries…';
    return;
  }

  if (state.games.length === 0) {
    els.resultCount.textContent = 'Catalog unavailable';
    return;
  }

  const isFiltered = Boolean(state.query.trim()) || state.source !== 'all';
  els.resultCount.textContent = isFiltered
    ? `${formatNumber(filtered.length)} of ${formatNumber(state.games.length)} games`
    : `${formatNumber(state.games.length)} games`;
}

function updateEmptyState() {
  const label = state.source === 'all' ? '' : SOURCE_BY_ID.get(state.source)?.label;
  const hasQuery = Boolean(state.query.trim());

  if (hasQuery && label) {
    els.emptyTitle.textContent = `No ${label} games match “${state.query.trim()}”`;
    els.emptyMessage.textContent = 'Try a different title or switch back to all sources.';
  } else if (hasQuery) {
    els.emptyTitle.textContent = `No games match “${state.query.trim()}”`;
    els.emptyMessage.textContent = 'Try a shorter search, or clear the search to browse everything.';
  } else if (label) {
    els.emptyTitle.textContent = `No ${label} games available`;
    els.emptyMessage.textContent = 'That source is unavailable right now. Try the other source.';
  } else {
    els.emptyTitle.textContent = 'No games found';
    els.emptyMessage.textContent = 'Try a shorter search or switch back to all sources.';
  }
}

function showPartialNotice(failures) {
  const failedLabels = failures.map((failure) => failure.source.label).join(' and ');
  const readyLabels = SOURCES.filter(
    (source) => state.status.get(source.id)?.state === 'ready'
  )
    .map((source) => source.label)
    .join(' and ');

  const strong = document.createElement('strong');
  strong.textContent = `${failedLabels} couldn’t load.`;

  const detail = document.createElement('span');
  detail.textContent = ` Showing ${formatNumber(state.games.length)} games from ${readyLabels}.`;

  els.noticeText.replaceChildren(strong, detail);
  els.noticeText.title = failures
    .map((failure) => `${failure.source.label}: ${failure.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`)
    .join('\n');
  els.notice.hidden = false;
}

function showCatalogError() {
  els.grid.replaceChildren();
  els.grid.hidden = true;
  els.grid.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
  els.emptyState.hidden = true;
  els.loadMoreWrap.hidden = true;
  els.notice.hidden = true;
  els.errorState.hidden = false;

  els.errorMessage.textContent =
    'All game sources could not be reached. This is usually a network, firewall, or CORS problem. Check your connection and try again.';
  els.resultCount.textContent = 'Catalog unavailable';
  updateStats();
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- Player */

async function openGame(game, trigger) {
  state.current = game;
  state.lastFocused = trigger || document.activeElement;

  els.playerTitle.textContent = game.title;
  els.playerSource.textContent =
    game.author || SOURCE_BY_ID.get(game.source)?.label || game.source;
  els.playerSourceDot.className = `source-dot source-${game.source}`;
  els.playerSourceDot.hidden = Boolean(game.author);
  els.player.dataset.source = game.source;
  els.frame.title = `Play ${game.title}`;
  state.preparedHtml = '';
  els.downloadGame.disabled = true;
  refreshTitle();

  els.player.hidden = false;
  document.body.classList.add('player-open');
  setBackgroundInert(true);
  els.closeGame.focus();

  await loadGameFrame(game);
}

function closePlayer() {
  if (els.player.hidden) return;

  const wrapper = getWrapperFullscreen();
  if (wrapper && wrapper.isActive()) {
    wrapper.exit().catch(() => {});
  } else if (document.fullscreenElement && document.exitFullscreen) {
    document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
  }
  document.body.classList.remove('is-fullscreen');

  state.frameToken += 1;
  state.framePhase = 'idle';
  state.current = null;
  state.preparedHtml = '';
  els.downloadGame.disabled = true;
  clearTimeout(state.frameHideTimer);
  state.frameHideTimer = 0;

  // Navigate away before hiding the overlay so the game's audio/scripts stop.
  els.frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');
  els.frame.src = 'about:blank';
  els.player.hidden = true;
  els.frameStatus.hidden = true;
  document.body.classList.remove('player-open');
  refreshTitle();
  setBackgroundInert(false);

  if (state.lastFocused && state.lastFocused.isConnected) {
    state.lastFocused.focus();
  }
  state.lastFocused = null;
}

async function loadGameFrame(game) {
  const token = (state.frameToken += 1);
  state.framePhase = 'loading';
  state.preparedHtml = '';
  els.downloadGame.disabled = true;
  els.frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');
  els.frame.src = 'about:blank';
  showFrameLoading(game);

  try {
    const html = await fetchGameHtml(game.playUrl);
    if (token !== state.frameToken) return;

    const prepared = prepareGameHtml(html, game.playUrl);
    state.framePhase = 'ready';
    state.preparedHtml = prepared;
    els.downloadGame.disabled = false;
    els.frame.srcdoc = prepared;

    // Normally the iframe's load event clears this. Keep a safety timer for
    // documents that never fire a load event (broken scripts, offline CDN).
    clearTimeout(state.frameHideTimer);
    state.frameHideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (token === state.frameToken) els.frameStatus.hidden = true;
    }, 8000);
  } catch (error) {
    if (token !== state.frameToken) return;
    state.framePhase = 'error';
    state.preparedHtml = '';
    els.downloadGame.disabled = true;
    console.error(`[Ghoulish] Could not load ${game.title}:`, error);
    showFrameError(game, error);
  }
}

async function fetchGameHtml(url) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), FRAME_TIMEOUT_MS);

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      mode: 'cors',
      credentials: 'omit',
      referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
      signal: controller.signal,
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }

    const html = await response.text();
    if (!html.trim()) {
      throw new Error('The game page was empty');
    }
    return html;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

/**
 * Make a fetched game document self-contained in an iframe:
 * - resolve a relative existing <base> against the game URL;
 * - inject a <base> when the game has none, so its CSS/JS/images load.
 */
function prepareGameHtml(html, gameUrl) {
  const baseHref = new URL('.', gameUrl).href;

  if (/<base\b[^>]*href\s*=/i.test(html)) {
    return html.replace(
      /(<base\b[^>]*href\s*=\s*)(["'])(.*?)\2/i,
      (match, prefix, quote, href) => {
        try {
          return `${prefix}${quote}${escapeAttribute(new URL(href, gameUrl).href)}${quote}`;
        } catch {
          return match;
        }
      }
    );
  }

  const baseTag = `<base href="${escapeAttribute(baseHref)}">`;

  if (/<head[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
    return html.replace(/<head[^>]*>/i, (head) => `${head}\n${baseTag}`);
  }

  if (/<html[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
    return html.replace(/<html[^>]*>/i, (htmlTag) => `${htmlTag}\n<head>${baseTag}</head>`);
  }

  return `${baseTag}\n${html}`;
}

function showFrameLoading(game) {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'status-card';

  const spinner = document.createElement('span');
  spinner.className = 'spinner';
  spinner.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

  const text = document.createElement('p');
  text.append(document.createTextNode('Loading '));
  const title = document.createElement('strong');
  title.textContent = game.title;
  text.append(title, document.createTextNode('…'));

  const hint = document.createElement('span');
  hint.className = 'status-hint';
  hint.textContent = `Fetching game files from ${safeHostname(game.playUrl)}`;

  card.append(spinner, text, hint);
  els.frameStatus.replaceChildren(card);
  els.frameStatus.hidden = false;
}

function showFrameError(game, error) {
  clearTimeout(state.frameHideTimer);

  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'status-card';

  const icon = document.createElement('span');
  icon.className = 'state-icon';
  icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  icon.textContent = '!';

  const heading = document.createElement('p');
  const strong = document.createElement('strong');
  strong.textContent = 'This game couldn’t be embedded.';
  heading.append(strong);

  const detail = document.createElement('span');
  detail.className = 'status-hint';
  detail.textContent = 'The game files may be blocked by your network or unavailable on the CDN.';

  const actions = document.createElement('div');
  actions.className = 'status-actions';

  const retry = document.createElement('button');
  retry.type = 'button';
  retry.className = 'btn btn-primary';
  retry.textContent = 'Try again';
  retry.addEventListener('click', () => loadGameFrame(game));

  const open = document.createElement('a');
  open.className = 'btn btn-quiet';
  open.href = game.playUrl;
  open.target = '_blank';
  open.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
  open.textContent = 'Open game URL';

  actions.append(retry, open);
  card.append(icon, heading, detail);

  if (error?.message) {
    card.title = error.message;
  }

  card.append(actions);
  els.frameStatus.replaceChildren(card);
  els.frameStatus.hidden = false;
}

function setBackgroundInert(inert) {
  for (const element of [els.topbar, els.catalog, els.footer, els.skipLink]) {
    if (element) element.inert = inert;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- Downloads */

async function downloadGame(game, button) {
  if (!game) return;
  setDownloadBusy(button, true);

  try {
    const html =
      state.current === game && state.preparedHtml
        ? state.preparedHtml
        : prepareGameHtml(await fetchGameHtml(game.playUrl), game.playUrl);

    saveGameHtml(html, game.title);
    showToast(`Saved “${game.title}” as an HTML file.`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[Ghoulish] Could not download ${game.title}:`, error);
    showToast(
      `Couldn’t download “${game.title}”. The game host blocked the file.`,
      'error'
    );
  } finally {
    setDownloadBusy(button, false);
    if (button === els.downloadGame) {
      button.disabled = !(state.current === game && Boolean(state.preparedHtml));
    }
  }
}

async function downloadSvg(button) {
  setDownloadBusy(button, true);
  setSettingsStatus('Preparing the SVG file…');

  try {
    const source = await getPortableSvgSource();
    if (!source) {
      setSettingsStatus(
        'Couldn’t build ghoulish 2.svg. Open the SVG directly, or serve this page next to the SVG file.'
      );
      return;
    }

    saveSvgFile(source);
    setSettingsStatus('Saved ghoulish 2.svg — the whole site in one file.');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Ghoulish] Could not download the SVG:', error);
    setSettingsStatus('Couldn’t prepare the SVG file. Open ghoulish 2.svg directly and try again.');
  } finally {
    setDownloadBusy(button, false);
  }
}

async function getPortableSvgSource() {
  try {
    const parentWindow = window.parent;
    if (parentWindow && parentWindow !== window) {
      const exportSvg = parentWindow.__GHOULISH_EXPORT_SVG__;
      if (typeof exportSvg === 'function') {
        const source = exportSvg();
        if (isPortableSvg(source)) return source;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // A cross-origin parent cannot hand us the outer SVG; try the file below.
  }

  if (isPortableSvg(window.__GHOULISH_SVG_SOURCE__)) {
    return window.__GHOULISH_SVG_SOURCE__;
  }

  const built = buildPortableSvg();
  if (built) return built;

  try {
    const url = new URL('ghoulish 2.svg', document.baseURI);
    const response = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!response.ok) return '';
    const source = await response.text();
    return isPortableSvg(source) ? source : '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

function buildPortableSvg() {
  const wrapperElement = document.getElementById('portable-wrapper');
  const wrapper = wrapperElement ? wrapperElement.textContent.trim() : '';
  if (!__GHOULISH_PRISTINE_HTML__ || !wrapper) return '';

  const iconElement = document.getElementById('favicon');
  const icon = (iconElement && iconElement.getAttribute('href')) || '';
  const safeIcon = icon.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/"/g, '"');
  const cdata = (value) => String(value).replace(/]]>/g, ']]]]><![CDATA[>');

  // Inline scripts cannot contain a literal closing script tag, so the two
  // closing tags below use an escaped slash; the generated SVG gets them back.
  const svg = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
     width="100%"
     height="100%"
     style="display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;background:#060506">
  <title id="doc-title">Ghoulish</title>
  <desc>Ghoulish unblocked games catalog. Open this SVG directly in a browser.</desc>
  <xhtml:link id="top-icon" rel="icon" href="${safeIcon}" />
  <foreignObject x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
    <xhtml:iframe
      id="app"
      title="Ghoulish unblocked games catalog"
      allow="autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad *; clipboard-write; clipboard-read; encrypted-media; accelerometer; gyroscope"
      referrerpolicy="no-referrer"
      style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#060506"
    ></xhtml:iframe>
  </foreignObject>
  <script type="text/plain" id="app-source"><![CDATA[
${cdata(__GHOULISH_PRISTINE_HTML__)}
  ]]><\/script>
  <script><![CDATA[
${cdata(wrapper)}
  ]]><\/script>
</svg>
`;

  return isPortableSvg(svg) ? svg : '';
}

function isPortableSvg(source) {
  return (
    typeof source === 'string' &&
    /<svg[\s>]/i.test(source) &&
    source.includes('id="app-source"')
  );
}

function saveSvgFile(source) {
  const blob = new Blob([source], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');

  link.href = url;
  link.download = 'ghoulish 2.svg';
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
}

function setDownloadBusy(button, busy) {
  if (!button) return;

  if (busy) {
    button.dataset.wasDisabled = button.disabled ? 'true' : 'false';
    button.disabled = true;
  } else {
    button.disabled = button.dataset.wasDisabled === 'true';
    delete button.dataset.wasDisabled;
  }

  button.classList.toggle('is-busy', busy);
  button.setAttribute('aria-busy', String(busy));
}

function saveGameHtml(html, title) {
  const blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');

  link.href = url;
  link.download = `${safeFileName(title)}.html`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
}

function safeFileName(title) {
  const name = String(title || '')
    .replace(/[<>:"\\/|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, '-')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

  return name || 'game';
}

let toastTimer = 0;

function showToast(message, tone = 'info') {
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  els.toast.textContent = message;
  els.toast.dataset.tone = tone;
  els.toast.hidden = false;
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    els.toast.hidden = true;
  }, 4200);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- Fullscreen */

function getWrapperFullscreen() {
  if (document.fullscreenEnabled || window.parent === window) return null;

  try {
    const bridge = window.parent.__GHOULISH_TOP_FULLSCREEN__;
    return bridge && bridge.enabled ? bridge : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function isFullscreenActive() {
  const wrapper = getWrapperFullscreen();
  if (wrapper) {
    try {
      return Boolean(wrapper.isActive());
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return Boolean(document.fullscreenElement);
}

function initFullscreen() {
  const wrapper = getWrapperFullscreen();
  const native =
    document.fullscreenEnabled && typeof els.player.requestFullscreen === 'function';

  if (!wrapper && !native) {
    els.fullscreenGame.hidden = true;
    return;
  }

  if (wrapper) {
    document.addEventListener('ghoulish:top-fullscreen-change', handleFullscreenChange);
  }
}

async function toggleFullscreen() {
  const wrapper = getWrapperFullscreen();

  if (wrapper) {
    try {
      if (wrapper.isActive()) {
        await wrapper.exit();
      } else {
        await wrapper.enter();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Ghoulish] Could not toggle fullscreen:', error);
      showToast('Fullscreen was blocked by the browser.', 'error');
    }
    handleFullscreenChange();
    return;
  }

  if (document.fullscreenElement) {
    try {
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Ghoulish] Could not exit fullscreen:', error);
    }
    return;
  }

  try {
    await els.player.requestFullscreen();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Ghoulish] Could not enter fullscreen:', error);
    showToast('Fullscreen was blocked by the browser.', 'error');
  }
}

function handleFullscreenChange() {
  const active = isFullscreenActive();
  if (!active) state.fullscreenExitedAt = Date.now();

  document.body.classList.toggle('is-fullscreen', active);

  els.fullscreenGame.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  els.fullscreenGame.setAttribute(
    'aria-label',
    active ? 'Exit fullscreen' : 'Enter fullscreen'
  );
  els.fullscreenGame.title = active ? 'Exit fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen';
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Settings */

function initSettings() {
  const stored = readSettings();
  if (stored.accent) applyCustomAccent(stored.accent);
  applyCloak(stored.cloak);
  applyBackground(stored.background);
  syncAccentInput();
}

function readSettings() {
  const injected = window.__GHOULISH_SETTINGS__;
  if (injected && typeof injected === 'object') return injected;

  try {
    const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY) || 'null');
    return stored && typeof stored === 'object' ? stored : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveSettings() {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      SETTINGS_KEY,
      JSON.stringify({
        cloak: state.cloak,
        accent: state.customAccent,
        background: { design: state.bgDesign, image: state.bgImage },
      })
    );
  } catch {
    // Storage can be unavailable on some file:// or private browsing setups.
  }
}

function openSettings() {
  if (state.settingsOpen || !els.player.hidden) return;

  state.lastSettingsFocus =
    document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body
      ? document.activeElement
      : els.openSettings;
  state.settingsOpen = true;
  setSettingsStatus('');
  syncAccentInput();
  syncBackgroundControls();
  els.settings.hidden = false;
  document.body.classList.add('settings-open');
  setBackgroundInert(true);
  els.settingsClose.focus();
}

function closeSettings() {
  if (!state.settingsOpen) return;

  state.settingsOpen = false;
  els.settings.hidden = true;
  document.body.classList.remove('settings-open');
  if (els.player.hidden) setBackgroundInert(false);

  const target = state.lastSettingsFocus;
  state.lastSettingsFocus = null;
  if (target && target.isConnected) target.focus();
}

function setSettingsStatus(message) {
  els.settingsStatus.textContent = message;
  els.settingsStatus.hidden = !message;
}

function applyCloak(id) {
  state.cloak = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(CLOAKS, id) ? id : 'off';
  const cloak = CLOAKS[state.cloak];
  setFavicon(cloak.icon || DEFAULT_FAVICON);
  updateCloakButtons();
  refreshTitle();
}

function setFavicon(href) {
  if (!els.favicon) return;
  const next = els.favicon.cloneNode(false);
  next.setAttribute('href', href);
  els.favicon.replaceWith(next);
  els.favicon = next;
}

function updateCloakButtons() {
  for (const button of els.cloakOptions.querySelectorAll('[data-cloak]')) {
    const active = button.dataset.cloak === state.cloak;
    button.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  }
}

function applyBackground(value) {
  const design =
    value &&
    typeof value === 'object' &&
    Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(BACKGROUNDS, value.design)
      ? value.design
      : 'embers';
  const image = value && typeof value.image === 'string'
    ? normalizeBackgroundUrl(value.image)
    : '';

  state.bgDesign = design;
  state.bgImage = image || '';
  applyBackgroundToBody();
  syncBackgroundControls();
}

function applyBackgroundPreset(id) {
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(BACKGROUNDS, id)) return;

  state.bgDesign = id;
  state.bgImage = '';
  applyBackgroundToBody();
  syncBackgroundControls();
  setSettingsStatus('');
}

function applyBackgroundImage(value) {
  const raw = String(value || '').trim();
  const image = normalizeBackgroundUrl(raw);

  if (!image) {
    setSettingsStatus(
      raw
        ? 'Use a full image URL that starts with http:// or https://.'
        : 'Paste an image URL first.'
    );
    els.bgImageUrl.focus();
    return false;
  }

  state.bgImage = image;
  applyBackgroundToBody();
  syncBackgroundControls();
  els.bgImageUrl.value = image;
  setSettingsStatus('');
  return true;
}

function clearBackgroundImage() {
  state.bgImage = '';
  applyBackgroundToBody();
  syncBackgroundControls();
  setSettingsStatus('');
}

function applyBackgroundToBody() {
  const style = document.body.style;
  document.body.dataset.bg = state.bgDesign;
  document.body.classList.toggle('has-bg-image', Boolean(state.bgImage));

  if (state.bgImage) {
    style.setProperty('--bg-image', cssBackgroundUrl(state.bgImage));
  } else {
    style.removeProperty('--bg-image');
  }
}

function syncBackgroundControls() {
  for (const button of els.bgOptions.querySelectorAll('[data-bg]')) {
    const active = !state.bgImage && button.dataset.bg === state.bgDesign;
    button.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
  }

  if (document.activeElement !== els.bgImageUrl) {
    els.bgImageUrl.value = state.bgImage;
  }

  els.bgImageClear.hidden = !state.bgImage;
  els.bgNote.textContent = state.bgImage
    ? 'Custom image active. Choose a preset to remove it.'
    : 'Choose a preset, or paste a direct image URL.';
}

function normalizeBackgroundUrl(value) {
  const raw = String(value || '').trim();
  if (!raw) return '';

  try {
    const url = new URL(raw);
    return url.protocol === 'http:' || url.protocol === 'https:' ? url.href : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function cssBackgroundUrl(value) {
  return `url("${String(value)}")`;
}

function refreshTitle() {
  const cloak = CLOAKS[state.cloak];
  if (cloak?.title) {
    document.title = cloak.title;
    return;
  }

  document.title = state.current ? `${state.current.title} — Ghoulish` : DEFAULT_TITLE;
}

function syncAccentInput() {
  const computed = normalizeHex(
    getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent')
  );
  const accent = state.customAccent || computed || '#ff3b4e';

  els.accentColor.value = accent;
  els.accentValue.textContent = accent.toUpperCase();
  els.accentReset.disabled = !state.customAccent;
  els.accentNote.textContent = state.customAccent
    ? 'Custom color is locked. Switching libraries will not change the page theme.'
    : 'Pick a color to lock every library to the same accent.';
}

function applyCustomAccent(value) {
  const normalized = normalizeHex(value);
  if (!normalized) return false;

  const rgb = hexToRgb(normalized);
  const hover = mixColor(rgb, [255, 255, 255], 0.16);
  const deep = mixColor(rgb, [0, 0, 0], 0.48);
  const style = document.body.style;

  style.setProperty('--accent', normalized);
  style.setProperty('--accent-hover', rgbToHex(hover));
  style.setProperty('--accent-rgb', rgb.join(', '));
  style.setProperty('--accent-deep', rgbToHex(deep));
  style.setProperty('--accent-deep-rgb', deep.join(', '));
  style.setProperty('--accent-ink', inkFor(rgb));

  state.customAccent = normalized;
  updateFilterButtons();
  syncAccentInput();
  return true;
}

function clearCustomAccent() {
  state.customAccent = null;

  for (const property of [
    '--accent',
    '--accent-hover',
    '--accent-rgb',
    '--accent-deep',
    '--accent-deep-rgb',
    '--accent-ink',
  ]) {
    document.body.style.removeProperty(property);
  }

  updateFilterButtons();
  syncAccentInput();
}

async function openInBlank() {
  let win = null;
  try {
    win = window.open('about:blank', '_blank');
  } catch {
    win = null;
  }

  if (!win) {
    setSettingsStatus('The new tab was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.');
    return;
  }

  closeSettings();

  let svgSource = '';
  try {
    svgSource = await getPortableSvgSource();
  } catch {
    svgSource = '';
  }

  try {
    const standalone = buildStandaloneDocument();
    const doc = win.document;

    // Do not use document.open()/write(): Chrome can replace the about:blank
    // address with the opener's URL. Building the DOM in place keeps the URL
    // bar on about:blank.
    win.__GHOULISH_SVG_SOURCE__ = svgSource;
    win.__GHOULISH_SETTINGS__ = {
      cloak: state.cloak,
      accent: state.customAccent,
      background: { design: state.bgDesign, image: state.bgImage },
    };
    doc.head.innerHTML = standalone.head;
    doc.body.innerHTML = standalone.body;

    for (const attribute of standalone.bodyAttributes) {
      doc.body.setAttribute(attribute.name, attribute.value);
    }

    const runner = doc.createElement('script');
    runner.textContent = standalone.script;
    doc.body.append(runner);
    win.focus();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Ghoulish] Could not open about:blank:', error);
    try {
      win.close();
    } catch {
      // The blocked tab may already be gone.
    }
    openSettings();
    setSettingsStatus('This browser would not let Ghoulish write to the new tab.');
  }
}

function buildStandaloneDocument() {
  const clone = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
  const head = clone.querySelector('head');
  const body = clone.querySelector('body');

  const icon = head.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]');
  if (icon) icon.setAttribute('href', DEFAULT_FAVICON);

  // The live <title> already reflects the active cloak; leave it so the copy
  // never flashes the Ghoulish name.
  const title = head.querySelector('title');
  if (title) title.textContent = document.title;

  // Remove the controller from the cloned markup so it does not sit inert in
  // the DOM; it is appended as a fresh script after the markup is installed.
  const scriptElement = body.querySelector('script');
  const scriptText = scriptElement ? scriptElement.textContent : '';
  if (scriptElement) scriptElement.remove();
  if (!scriptText) throw new Error('The app controller could not be serialized');

  body.classList.remove('player-open', 'settings-open');
  body.dataset.theme = 'all';

  const settings = body.querySelector('#settings');
  if (settings) settings.hidden = true;

  const settingsStatus = body.querySelector('#settings-status');
  if (settingsStatus) {
    settingsStatus.hidden = true;
    settingsStatus.textContent = '';
  }

  const toast = body.querySelector('#toast');
  if (toast) {
    toast.hidden = true;
    toast.textContent = '';
    delete toast.dataset.tone;
  }

  const downloadButton = body.querySelector('#download-game');
  if (downloadButton) downloadButton.disabled = true;

  // The copy fetches its own catalog, so skip the rendered cards and let the
  // inline controller show skeletons again.
  const grid = body.querySelector('#grid');
  if (grid) {
    grid.replaceChildren();
    grid.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
  }

  const bodyAttributes = Array.from(body.attributes).map((attribute) => ({
    name: attribute.name,
    value: attribute.value,
  }));

  return {
    head: head.innerHTML,
    body: body.innerHTML,
    bodyAttributes,
    script: scriptText,
  };
}

function normalizeHex(value) {
  let hex = String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/^#/, '');

  if (hex.length === 3) {
    hex = hex
      .split('')
      .map((character) => character + character)
      .join('');
  }

  return /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(hex) ? `#${hex.toLowerCase()}` : null;
}

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const value = normalizeHex(hex) || '#000000';
  return [
    parseInt(value.slice(1, 3), 16),
    parseInt(value.slice(3, 5), 16),
    parseInt(value.slice(5, 7), 16),
  ];
}

function rgbToHex(rgb) {
  return `#${rgb
    .map((channel) =>
      Math.round(Math.min(255, Math.max(0, channel)))
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(2, '0')
    )
    .join('')}`;
}

function mixColor(rgb, target, amount) {
  return rgb.map((channel, index) => channel + (target[index] - channel) * amount);
}

function relativeLuminance(rgb) {
  const linear = rgb.map((channel) => {
    const value = channel / 255;
    return value <= 0.03928 ? value / 12.92 : ((value + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  });

  return 0.2126 * linear[0] + 0.7152 * linear[1] + 0.0722 * linear[2];
}

function inkFor(rgb) {
  const luminance = relativeLuminance(rgb);
  const onBlack = (luminance + 0.05) / 0.05;
  const onWhite = 1.05 / (luminance + 0.05);
  return onBlack >= onWhite ? '#14060a' : '#fffafb';
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ Helpers */

function formatNumber(value) {
  return numberFormatter.format(value);
}

function getInitials(title) {
  const words = String(title)
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N} ]+/gu, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (words.length === 0) return '?';
  if (words.length === 1) return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${words[0][0]}${words[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
}

/**
 * Stable pseudo-random hue for fallback art. Each source keeps its own narrow
 * colour band so missing covers still read as that library: crimson for
 * GN-Math, teal for Lumin, amber for Noah's Tutoring.
 */
function hueFor(game) {
  let hash = 0;
  const value = game.id;
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + value.charCodeAt(index)) | 0;
  }

  const variation = Math.abs(hash);
  if (game.source === LUMIN.id) return 164 + (variation % 28);
  if (game.source === NOAHS_TUTORING.id) return 26 + (variation % 16);
  if (game.source === GN_MATH.id) return 334 + (variation % 22);
  return 22 + (variation % 18);
}

function safeHostname(url) {
  try {
    return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
  } catch {
    return 'the game CDN';
  }
}

function escapeAttribute(value) {
  return String(value)
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>');
}

})();
